sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Smells Like Gunpowder is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hey, warrior! Time to get yourself ready, because the Arena is evolving again. I arranged a shipment of explosive charges for a device you're already familiar with, and don't even ask what it cost me. If you've spent all this time thinking BlastGang would always be some harmless game of cat and mouse with no real risk, it's time to grow up. Consider all the previous matches training. The real work starts now. Go find out if you've got enough guts to work with equipment this dangerous."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Play a match in BlastGang mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 300,000 Roubles
- 30 GP coins
- 1× Lega Medal
